explanation.text:
Your product is likely to meet the AfCFTA rules of origin.

Main reasons:
- No imported ingredient is classified in heading 19.01.
- These manufacturing processes are eligible under AfCFTA guidelines: roasting of millet and soya, cooking by extrusion and drum drying of the cooked paste.

What to do next:
- Keep your supplier declarations, invoices and production records together.
- You decide whether to apply. GRA Customs and the National AfCFTA Approval Committee make the official decision.

expected.derivation: Ingredients are in headings 10.08, 12.01, 04.02 and 17.01, not heading 19.01. Imported milk powder and sugar do not affect a heading-change rule. Roasting, extrusion cooking and drum drying in Ghana are not Art. 7(1) operations. Box 12: SX.
